g.text: Inside one host: the real interfaces behind an overlay network
Names are what Docker 29.9.2 actually creates. The VXLAN device is NOT in the host namespace.
1 app sends a frame to the MAC of 10.0.1.7 2 veth moves it across the namespace boundary 3 br0 switches by MAC; a remote MAC is behind vxlan0
4 vxlan0 finds the remote VTEP IP, wraps (UDP 4789, VNI 4097) 5 the HOST routing table picks the egress interface 6 tailscale0 encrypts it and sends it on
No local/dev is set on vxlan0: the kernel routes the wrapped packet using the host table, so with Tailscale addresses as VTEP IPs it leaves through tailscale0.
Dashed blue = north-south traffic (to the Internet) that never touches VXLAN.
